 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Mirror-tile a grid 3x3, keeping the original in the center."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = []
    for tile_r in range(3):
        source_rows = range(h) if tile_r == 1 else range(h - 1, -1, -1)
        for r in source_rows:
            row = []
            for tile_c in range(3):
                source_cols = range(w) if tile_c == 1 else range(w - 1, -1, -1)
                row.extend(grid[r][c] for c in source_cols)
            out.append(row)
    return out
"
